== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|The [[Transcendent Ruins]] are massive, ancient structures built by legendary masters that predated living [[sacred artists]]. Appearing as a colossal pyramid or mountain of stacked brown stone, the structure is large enough to scrape the clouds and dwarf everything in its vicinity. The Ruins function as a dark, deadly [[labyrinth]] filled with ancient secrets and immense power, though they are also home to dangerous [[Remnants]] and [[dreadbeasts]]. A primary draw for those exploring the site is a legendary spear located at the top, which possesses the potential to elevate a faction to heavenly status. The Ruins possess the ability to draw in [[vital aura]] from hundreds of miles around, a process that can leave the surrounding environment dim. Following the opening of the [[Soulsmith foundry]] at its peak, the structure reached an equilibrium where it began relying on a steady trickle of aura from its immediate area rather than massive intake. Recently, the Ruins rose into the sky following violent seismic activity. This event led to the formation of the [[Five Factions Alliance]], a makeshift encampment of shacks and shops built around the base of the structure. While many [[sacred artists]] initially flocked to the site to seek its treasures, the population has fluctuated as resources are harvested and the aura levels shift.}}

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|The Ruins serve as a site for excursions where the School's High Elder requires the presence of [[Lindon]] and [[Yerin]]. This location is filled with tunnels, thick [[vital aura]], and numerous [[Remnants]] and [[dreadbeasts]]. Within the area, an enormous block can sink into a wall, and [[scripts]] are visible upon the surfaces. [[Eithan]], who has scrounged [[sacred beasts]] from the site and claims it as his own home, notes that a [[script-circle]] exists which could detonate the [[Transcendent Ruins]]. Ultimately, the [[First Fisher]] intends to clean out the area, which contains contents that must be catalogued.}}
